holes_in_opposing_case: The NZD-lower camp (dollar-king, perma-bear, rate-dove, trend-follower) never reconstructs an NZ mechanism. Their primary trades are USDCAD, CORRA_2027-09, CORRA_2027-06, and SOFR_2027-09. NZD_DOWN is a USD-up/risk-off tag, not a priced NZ assumption they test. Packet NZ facts they ignore: Q2 GDP 0.2% q/q beat, India FTA, inflation gauge 80 versus AU 82, and AUDUSD +0.20% 1m versus NZDUSD -3.90% 1m.

dollar-king and trend-follower's strongest claim is a continuing post-FOMC USD bid (Fed 3.75-4.00, SOFR 3.85, SR3Z6 4.32 / SR3U7 4.755). That is a USD-leg claim. On 18 Sep USDJPY was +1.41% while AUDUSD was still +0.09% and NZDUSD -0.56%; the AU-NZ residual printed in AUDNZD, not in USDCAD or SR3U7. A USD-higher view can be true and still leave AUDNZD too high.

perma-bear and rate-dove own Canada: CORRA 2.29 versus 107-122bp of 2027 hike premium against labor 38 and core near 2%. Receiving CRAU27/CRAM27 does not imply NZD lower versus AUD. Mapping a BoC overpricing into Oceania spot is a non sequitur, and NZ rates are unavailable so they cannot even claim an NZ policy-error analog.

perma-bull shares the NZ-higher reading but puts it in NZDUSD. That expression loads the exact Fed path dollar-king and trend-follower are selling: delivered 25bp plus SR3 still tightening. If their USD bid is even partly right, long NZDUSD dies while short AUDNZD can still work. perma-bull's own path_to_current_price already admits AUDUSD +0.20% 1m is the control that the dump is NZ-not-USD; the cleaner instrument for that residual is AUDNZD, which they cite as a flag then refuse to trade.

trend-follower tags aud_view neutral and nzd_view lower, which is an implicit long-AUDNZD. They give no AU housing versus NZ GDP/FTA comparison to justify that residual. Neutral AUD plus lower NZD is the priced 1m path (+4.27% AUDNZD) that 16 Sep news already argued against.
attack: Strongest opposing claim: post-hike USD stays bid, so NZD as a high-beta stays lower (dollar-king/trend-follower). Weakness: they do not decompose AUD versus NZD. Packet control is AUDUSD not stretched (1y 76th, +0.20% 1m) while NZDUSD was dumped and AUDNZD extended after AU-negative/NZ-positive news. USD-up days already happened (18 Sep USDJPY +1.41%) without stopping the idiosyncratic NZ underperformance versus AUD.
Canada-receive seats (perma-bear, rate-dove) are fighting CORRA hike premium, not NZD. CAD_DOWN plus NZD_DOWN is regime coloring. It does not identify a closing mechanism for AUDNZD 1.2468.

perma-bull's NZDUSD long is the USD-contaminated twin of this seat's view. Same catalysts, worse denominator. Unhedged to AUD, as they state, is a choice to own Fed residual they already documented as not the driver.
defense: Original remains short AUDNZD. Intended differential is AU housing channel biting (stamp-duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, Sydney/Melbourne >7% off peak) plus still-priced AONIA hikes (4.35, Oct 4.565, Dec 4.725) versus NZ GDP beat and India FTA with inflation gauges nearly identical (82 vs 80). That lives in the cross.

NZD higher here is versus AUD, not versus USD. usd_view stays not_relevant. Concession to a USD bid would kill perma-bull's NZDUSD, not this trade, unless AUDUSD and NZDUSD fall together and leave AUDNZD unchanged or higher — that is already the stated invalidation.

Uncertainty preserved: NZ OCR/2Y missing, AUDNZD carry unknown, CFTC/CME positioning unavailable, NZ labor 32 / activity 47 remain a known level risk. Those gaps cut against long NZDUSD more than against an AU-NZ relative. Concede if post-18-Sep AUDNZD makes new highs because NZ activity confirms the labor recession and FTA/GDP do not reprice NZD, or if a pure USD bid moves both USD legs equally.
